question: Must this stored-model and destructive-workflow PR provide a real Postgres migration run and live transfer/delete/cleanup transcript before merge, or is the existing SQLite run, generated adapter parity, tests, and icon screenshot sufficient?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but the review contract requires real behavior evidence and upgrade proof for stored-model changes; the supplied artifact leaves key Postgres and destructive lifecycle behavior test-only.

options.title: Require complete runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted real-setup transfer/delete/cleanup run and execute the included migration test against a disposable Postgres database before merge.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Treat the SQLite migration run, generated SQL parity, focused automated coverage, visible icon screenshot, and passing checks as sufficient.

recommendation.title: Require complete runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted real-setup transfer/delete/cleanup run and execute the included migration test against a disposable Postgres database before merge.
